description.value:
While in dim light or darkness, become invisible until you take a hostile action, Cast a Spell, or leave dim light.

  • You may Sustain this to maintain it for up to 1 minute.

From 10th level, it no longer ends when you take a hostile action, only if you leave dim light.

Drag Living Shadow: Invisible from the compendium onto your token, or apply it from this item's effect, and remove it when it ends.
